title: Discriminative AI and Machine Learning
lead: Covers: what machine learning is, the three ways of learning, data vocabulary, supervised learning (classification, regression, forecasting), the donor example, data preparation (feature engineering, Z-score), unsupervised learning, dimensionality and PCA, training / testing / bias / variance, model scores and cross-validation, and the supervised methods themselves: linear regression, error (SSE), gradient descent and logistic regression. No prior lecture attendance needed.
